verdict.rationale: Mangopay exposes a full REST API/SDKs for creating users and driving KYC/KYB onboarding (docs-34), plus an OpenAPI spec and a documented MCP server (probe-2, probe-3) and an llms.txt built for AI agents (probe-1, docs-28), which together plausibly let an agent create seller accounts and progress onboarding. However there is no evidence of scoped/limited API credentials for agent use, nor any explicit mechanism for querying or resolving 'requirements-due' verification states as a named object/workflow. Missing for 10: scoped-credential/API-key model for agents, explicit requirements-due state API, and hands-on confirmation the MCP server exposes these seller-onboarding operations.
